name: Baby Piggies #91
description:
Baby Piggies 🐷 999

A vibrant pixel art universe where tiny, adorable baby piggies rule the blockchain!

While the majority of the collection features unique, charming little piggies equipped with all kinds of outfits and expressions, a few legendary 1/1 masterworks stand as rare mythical bosses of the realm.

Hand-crafted pixel by pixel. Collect them, trade them, and join the litter.
